name: Barbarian Warpaint
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 8th; Slot: –; Price: 3,000 gp; Weight: 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Barbarian warpaint endows the subject with one of the powers listed below for 30 minutes after applying it. The wearer must select a power immediately after applying the paint, which requires one full minute. One pot of warpaint is sufficient to paint the face of one creature. A pot of warpaint has the ability to endow one of the following powers:

Hard to Kill: the wearer is hard to kill. This effect works identically to the Diehard feat.
Deadly Striker: The wearer’s threat range with a single type of weapon increases by 1.
Swift Striker: The wearer can make one extra attack of opportunity each round.
Skilled Combatant: The wearer can choose to take a –2 penalty on melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to gain a +2 dodge bonus to his Armor Class. He can only use this ability when he declares he is making an attack or a full-attack action with a melee weapon. The effects last until his next turn.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells bear’s endurance, bull’s strength, cat’s grace; Cost: 1,500 gp
